title: Spreading speeds for Fisher-KPP equations with slowly decaying initial data in an almost periodic setting
summary: This paper investigates the long-times behavior of the Fisher-KPP equation with slowly decaying initial data in an almost periodic medium. We mainly focus on two classes of initial data: exponentially decaying initial data and inital data that decay more slowly than any exponential function. Employing the Hamilton-Jacobi approach, we provide a unified framwork for analyzing the Cauchy problem with initial data in both cases.
